_about: Condition vocabulary of find_conditions (detail 2.2) other than periods and frequencies (those stay in
reused/q_rules.py): basis axes and their words, comparison and calculation patterns, calc hints, compound
nouns of time words and the period unit words. basis_axes, basis_not_followed_by, calc_than and
calc_patterns are the old A pipeline rules (src/claview/aflow/rules.py, commit 55fd41b) moved out of the
code unchanged and in the same order (order decides overlaps). The grammar words of 2.2 (X-byeol mark,
negation, units, list and exclusion words, relation, function and display words, marker particles) moved
to lexicon.json (plan 08 T2). Ambiguous words (흐름, a lone 기준) are not condition words (detail 2.2).

ambiguous_basis_words._about: Condition words with two meanings (plan 04, 2-3 check 3): '전망' is a survey view of tables that have it (실적/전망) and a forecast elsewhere. Such a word is certain only when a table of the requirement's indicator holds it (a value or its table name).

calc_hints._about: Change expressions (user decision 10/18 b): not conditions; kept on the judgement as calc hints, protected from predicate stripping and not counted as leftover words.

time_word_compounds._about: A frequency or period word written with no space before one of these general nouns is part of a compound noun (연간지표, 분기자료), not a frequency or period (M1-1 review). Not after 별/마다 (분기별자료 stays quarterly).
